function: Excluded (system): U-Net based network generates the regional CIR magnitude from a building map for one transmit antenna and single-antenna receiving points, no MIMO array, no RIS (pp. 4, 8, 9, 11).
notes: Excluded at the system check. The learned model (PIDRTN, U-Net blocks with a parameter-free ray transmission module) turns a building-height map into the cumulative CIR magnitude over a 100 m x 100 m region, which fits area 2 (synthesis and estimation of the channel), so the function check passes. The link has one transmit antenna and single-antenna receiving points: p. 4: "This study considers each antenna element as an ideal omnidirectional antenna, disregarding its polarization configuration."; p. 4: "we fix the transmitter at the center in this study"; p. 8: "a transmitting antenna is deployed at the center of the scenario"; p. 9: "512 × 512 receiving points are uniformly arranged". There is no RIS. MIMO appears only as motivation, and the MIMO channel matrix is left for later: p. 11: "In future work, we will further investigate the estimation of MIMO channel matrices under a more refined spatial discretization." The work does report quantitative results (p. 12: NRMSE 0.3403 for U-Net, 0.1226 for PIDRTN, 0.0969 for PIDRTN-A against ray tracing), so the results check is not the reason. Code and dataset are stated open at github.com/WangShuchen97/PIDRTN (p. 2, footnote 1). If the reviewer reads building-map-to-CIR generation as outside area 2, the exclusion code would be function instead of system.
